lines.beaver: 박 교수님, 한빛건설 사건을 어떻게 보십니까?
lines.beaver_en: Professor Park, how do you see the Hanbit Construction case?
lines.beaver_roman: Bak gyosunim, hanbitgeonseol sageoneul eotteoke bosimnikka?
lines.learner: 이 사건은 비리가 오랫동안 이어져 왔음을 보여 줍니다.
lines.en: This case shows the corruption has gone on for a long time.
lines.roman: I sageoneun biriga oraetdongan ieojeo wasseumeul boyeo jumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How did it first come to light?
lines.learner: 직원 한 명의 내부 고발로 경위가 밝혀졌습니다.
lines.en: An employee's whistleblowing revealed what happened.
lines.roman: Jigwon han myeongui naebu goballo gyeongwiga balkyeojyeotseumnida.

lines.learner: 아무 해명 없이 무응답과 인터뷰 거부로 일관했습니다.
lines.en: With no explanation, they stayed silent and refused interviews.
lines.roman: Amu haemyeong eopsi mueungdapgwa inteobyu geoburo ilgwanhaetseumnida.

lines.learner: 안전 법규를 무시해서 주민의 권리를 침해했습니다.
lines.en: They ignored safety rules and violated residents' rights.
lines.roman: Anjeon beopgyureul musihaeseo juminui gwollireul chimhaehaetseumnida.

lines.en: Houses collapsed and the forest was badly damaged.
No, most of the perpetrators fled abroad.

lines.beaver_en: Some citizens even demand the death penalty.
lines.learner: 저는 사형보다 확실한 처벌이 중요하다고 봅니다.
lines.en: I think certain punishment matters more than the death penalty.
lines.roman: Jeoneun sahyeongboda hwaksilhan cheobeori jungyohadago bomnida.

lines.en: The compensation still hasn't been paid.

lines.beaver_en: Is the compensation late because the trial is dragging on?
lines.learner: 재판이 늦어지는 것은 제도가 약함을 말해 줍니다.
lines.en: The delayed trial tells us the system is weak.
lines.roman: Jaepani neujeojineun geoseun jedoga yakameul malhae jumnida.

lines.learner: 내부 고발자가 보호받는 사회가 되어야 합니다.
lines.en: We need a society where whistleblowers are protected.
lines.roman: Naebu gobaljaga bohobanneun sahoega doeeoya hamnida.
